gloss: some; some kind of; in some way

definitions.gloss: some; some kind of; in some way
definitions.explanation: Indicates an unspecified or vague something. Used when the speaker cannot or does not need to specify exactly what kind or in what manner.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}らか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Some kind of countermeasure is needed.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}らか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to cooperate in some way.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なん}らか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧だ。
examples.english: There must be some kind of cause for this problem.

notes:
{何|なん}らか is the indefinite form of ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ら (which means "(not) at all" in negative sentences or "any" in questions).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何|なん}らか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun — some kind of [noun]
- {何|なん}らか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — in some form
- {何|なん}らか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — for some reason
- {何|なん}らか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧ — some kind of effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧ — something (more colloquial, concrete)
- {何|なん}らか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — some kind of (more formal, vague)
- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦かしら→かしら：06921_kashira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — some or other (slightly less formal than {何|なん}らか)
